payload.summary: Two divergent head pointers in orch-state.json — .head (canonical, dispatch-authoritative) and legacy .task_board.head disagree.

head_top_level.verdict: CORRECT / current — this is what the dev-team :07 tick reads (docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md:189 jq -c '.head')

task_board_head.verdict: STALE — that task is status=done_verified (RESOLVED); pointer never advanced after CI-RED closed

payload.why_not_blocking: Dispatch path (dev-team) reads top-level .head which is correct; FIX-BCTC-BANK-PDF-OCR-RASTERIZE is already IN_PROGRESS claimed_by=dev-team. .task_board.head is read only by PO grooming scripts (po-fda9-groom-ready.jq, po-vn-macro-tooling-sprint-open.jq, po-s54-*.jq) where a resolved-task head is benign context.
payload.root_cause: Different PO script generations write DIFFERENT head fields: newer po-s64 family writes top-level .head; older po-s54 / po-fda9 family writes .task_board.head. Two head SSOTs => guaranteed drift each time the two families interleave. This is the SSOT-duplicate-key class (see docs/architecture-briefs/2026-06-13-orch-state-read-discipline.md).
payload.recommended_fix: Board-hygiene pass (PO single-writer): pick ONE canonical head field (top-level .head per orch-state-access.md §1, which dev-team already reads), make .task_board.head either mirror it or be removed, and converge ALL PO grooming scripts onto the canonical field so the two families stop diverging. Fix is the script-family unification (root), not a one-off head rewrite (symptom).
payload.do_not: Router did NOT write either head field (PO is single board writer). No spawn issued for this — non-blocking, folds into next PO grooming/triage cycle.
